risk_summary: The disclosure is highly detailed and quantitatively explains earnings, interest-rate and derivative exposures, but its extensive non-GAAP adjustments may complicate comparison with GAAP results and peers. Reported performance improved through derivative gains and lower credit-loss provisions, while net interest income and yield declined and earnings remain exposed to market-driven derivative volatility.
